name: Bloodline Disciples — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Bloodline Disciples from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Bloodline Disciple" but are not part of the Bloodline Disciples entry, which is unchanged.

Multiclassing: A bloodline disciple cannot multiclass as another subclass of the same Prestige Class; for example, a bard who has levels in maestro disciple cannot take levels in dragon disciple as well.

Wildblooded: A wildblooded sorcerer who gains levels in bloodline disciple advances the replacement bloodline powers as she would for the usual powers of her bloodline. For example, a sage sorcerer with levels in arcane disciple would stack her disciple levels and her sorcerer levels for the purpose of the arcane bolt bloodline power.

Crossblooded: A crossblooded sorcerer or crossblooded bloodrager who gains levels in bloodline disciple only advances the bloodline powers matching the subclass she selected. The character still can gain bloodline powers she doesn’t possess through her bloodline disciple class features. For example, a celestial/destined crossblooded sorcerer with levels in celestial disciple who selected the 9th-level power of the destined bloodline does not advance that power; she still gains the wings power when she attains to the 9th level in the celestial disciple class, using her celestial disciple level only for the purpose of that power.
